messages:
alina: Flagging a docs/runtime mismatch on /v1/rerank. The reference shows each item with a single `score` field, but the service returns `scores` (array of floats) per candidate. Our JS snippet assumes `item.score` and ends up reading undefined.
ryan: Can you paste the actual response you saw?
alina: Sure, from staging: 
```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "How to onboard",
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1", "scores": [0.89, 0.05]},
    {"id":"c2", "scores": [0.72, 0.15]}
  ]
}
```
kate: Interesting. Docs generator must be using an older schema where `score` was a single aggregated value. Also noticed the request param examples use `top_k` in some snippets and `k` in others  that's going to confuse integrators.
ryan: Oof. Impact: JS quickstart demo fails when accessing `.score` and some integrations pass `k` and get ignored. We'll need a PR to sync OpenAPI examples and snippet templates.
kate: I'll open a PR to update the examples: (1) change response examples to show `scores` array per candidate, (2) update snippets to aggregate/display top score via `Math.max(...item.scores)`, (3) standardize request param name to `top_k` everywhere and add a migration note that `k` is deprecated.
doc-ci: PR created by kate: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5333 
ryan: For the JS snippet, please add an explicit example line: `const best = Math.max(...candidate.scores)` and a short comment explaining older code used `candidate.score`.
kate: Added JS and Python examples. Python example uses: `best = max(candidate.get('scores', []))` with a default guard. Also added a tiny migration blurb under "Breaking changes": `k -> top_k` and `score -> scores (array)` mapping.
alina: Can you also grep the repo for `.score` usages? I found a couple in the community quickstart and a workshop notebook.
kate: Yup did a repo sweep and opened a follow-up commit to update the quickstart and notebook examples.
doc-ci: docs-linter run queued for PR #5333.
doc-ci: docs-linter passed for PR #5333  https://ci.redwood.ai/14001
kate: Merged. Preview live: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/rerank showing the new response shape and updated snippets.
ryan: I'll regenerate the JS SDK examples and run the unit tests against staging. Alina, can you take Python regen?
alina: On it. Ran python client smoke against staging; fixes work and examples parse correctly.
ryan: Confirmed JS quickstart demo now prints the top score correctly. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
